messages.author: f2ff9b373a30182c
messages.subject: Comparison of SRI now and 10 years ago
parts:
Hello.

I'm new to this forum.
I'm working on the sleep regularity index, which will be measured now and compared with the same measurement from 10 years ago. However, I don't seem to have this “SleepRegularityIndex” variable extracted from my 2014 database.
Is there any way of doing this calculation with the variables made available by the GGIR, in part 4 or part 5, in the year 2014?

Thank you in advance for your help.  

Sincerely,
Camila.

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Comparison of SRI now and 10 years ago
parts:
Hi Camila,
The only solution is to reprocess your data.

It may further be good to mention that GGIR's SRI is actually more of a rest regularity index. I am working on expanding GGIR part 6 to include SRI that is more in line with the one proposed by Windred. I hope to include these updates before the summer.

Best,

Vincent
